name: Dr. Anthony Hoang
bio:
Dr. Anthony Hoang is a Long Beach and Lakewood native who feels a deep sense of pride bringing exceptional dental care to the community he grew up in. He attended Lakewood High School before earning his degree at UC Irvine, then went on to receive his DMD from Tufts University School of Dental Medicine in Boston in 2014. He furthered his training through a General Practice Residency at the Loma Linda VA Medical Center, where he provided comprehensive dental care to veterans — an experience that sharpened both his clinical skills and his commitment to serving others.

What Dr. Hoang loves most about dentistry isn't the procedures — it's the people. He takes genuine pride in building lasting relationships with his patients and creating an environment where even the most anxious visitors leave feeling comfortable and cared for. At Spring St. Dentistry, you're not just a chart number; you're a neighbor, and Dr. Hoang treats you like one.

Whether you're coming in for a routine cleaning or a complete smile makeover, Dr. Hoang is committed to delivering high-quality, comprehensive care tailored to your individual needs. He looks forward to welcoming every patient through the door and being a trusted part of your family's health for years to come.
